name: Piscivorous fish
description: Medium-sized fish-eaters of the open water and the margins. Functional group aggregating the source's 'others piscivorous fish' compartment - Acestrorhynchus spp., Boulengerella maculata, Brachyplatystoma vaillantii, Cynodon gibbus, Hoplias spp., Oxydoras niger, Platynematichthys notatus, Pinirampus pirinampu, Pseudoplatystoma spp. and Serrasalmus spp. - a guild of predatory fishes measured together by the source.
